What I'm proposing:
- Salary: a mid-cycle merit increase effective first full payroll after approval (target +9% base; current base $145,000) — this would be an early merit outside the normal cadence.
- One-time probationary retention bonus: $7,500 lump sum paid next payroll, contingent on 6-month retention clause (simple retention letter).
- Equity: recommend a small refresh grant (0.25% target) to be discussed with Comp Committee; manager willing to defer final grant until committee review but requesting pre-approval to include in offer pipeline if committee approves.

Why this is exceptional:
- Arjun shipped two high-impact features in the first 8 weeks that accelerated a customer milestone for a paid pilot (internal revenue impact).
- Several cross-team leads flagged his technical ownership; losing him to another offer would slow our roadmap.
- We have budget (team discretionary pool) but the salary bump exceeds manager-only approval thresholds.

Asks:
1) Please advise whether we can approve the one-time $7.5k retention bonus under manager discretion, and confirm payroll code to use.
2) If salary increase requires Comp Committee approval, can we get an expedited review this week?
3) If approved, what's the earliest effective date for payroll processing?

Attachments: Arjun_90day_perf.pdf, comp_proposal_sheet.xlsx

Thanks — I can jump on a 15-min sync if helpful.
